# GymButler Documentation

[Home](https://gymbutler.cavender.io/): All-in-one gym companion for calculating percentages, converting weights, and timing workouts.

## Features

- [Weight Percentages](https://gymbutler.cavender.io/percentages): Calculate training percentages from your working weight with customizable ranges (min/max/step).
- [Weight Converter](https://gymbutler.cavender.io/convert): Convert between kilograms and pounds instantly with handy conversion tips.
- [Timer](https://gymbutler.cavender.io/timer): Countdown timer with round tracking for interval training. Track best, worst, and average round times.
- [Stopwatch](https://gymbutler.cavender.io/stopwatch): Track rest times with lap functionality and statistics.

## About

- [About GymButler](https://gymbutler.cavender.io/about): Learn about the features, availability, and contact information.
